label: D2 late in the episode, mainly after choosing a2 or after a previous non-reward
explanation: Fires only at D2 (zero at D1 and GO) and only on unrewarded-input steps. It is strongly tied to episode position: the rate rises from 0.4% at trials 0-9 to 15% at trials 80-99, and trials 50-99 hold 95% of the mass. It also tracks the low end of the model value head (value < 5.2 gives 3.4x lift), which falls late in the episode. It is biased toward a2 / S2 at D2 (87% of the mass when the GO choice was a2) and toward a previous trial that was unrewarded (64% of the mass). Most of the mass falls on late D2 steps with a2 chosen or the last trial unrewarded (dev F1 0.56, mass recall 0.81), but precision is only about 0.45: many such steps stay silent. Top activations (around 2.2) are late-episode D2 steps after a2 to S2c where the previous trial went unrewarded. It does not respond to whether this trial is common or rare, or to the future reward. All variables used are observed at D2. Likely a graded time-remaining / low-value signal gated to D2 and modulated by choice identity.
